capabilities: display a floating table of contents on the right side of the editor
fade inactive headings into short lines and show only the active heading
keep the TOC in sync across editing and reading modes
update the TOC instantly as headings or content change
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff, and the README only describes manual installation from GitHub releases; there are no usage examples or screenshots.
intentEvidence: An Obsidian plugin that adds a floating Table of Contents styled after Sspai
motivation: The author wants an extremely minimalist TOC so users can focus on writing and reading, modeled on the Sspai site's design.
problem: Obsidian's outline panel takes space and shows all headings at once, which can distract from focused reading and writing.

relations.evidence: A floating table of contents inspired by Sspai.

summary: Floating table of contents styled after Sspai that sits on the right side and shows only the active heading in full.
